# Copilot Instructions

- This is an **Astro 7 static site** built with **bun 1.4.4** (bun's runtime reports Node 26.3.0, satisfying Astro's >=22.23.4 requirement). There is no React, Hono, SSR runtime, client-side router, or hydration runtime. Do not introduce `react-router`, `react-helmet-async`, or JSX.
- Follow Astro's project structure: all source lives under `src/` (`pages/`, `layouts/`, `components/`, `styles/`, `lib/`, `scripts/`, `data/`, `assets/`, `content/`, `consts.ts`, `types.ts`, `content.config.ts`). Only `public/` is copied verbatim to the build. Repo root holds config plus `scripts/` build tooling only; never add loose `.ts` source files there again.
- **Articles are an Astro content collection.** Markdown files live in `src/content/posts/`; `src/content.config.ts` defines the collection with `glob()` and `postSchema` from `src/lib/post-schema.ts`. Read posts through `await getPosts()` in `src/lib/posts.ts` (wraps `getCollection('posts')`); article pages use `getPostEntries()` to also obtain the raw `CollectionEntry` for rendering. Never reintroduce `_posts/`, `services/posts.json`, or a custom frontmatter compiler; there is no `build:content` step.
- Routing is file-based under `src/pages/`. Dynamic article routes come from `async getStaticPaths()` and must use `post.permalink` (generated once at build time in UTC from the frontmatter `date`). Static endpoints (`rss.xml`, `sitemap.xml`, `card/*.png`) that need posts must be `async GET()` and await `getPosts()`.
- Frontmatter `title` and `date` are required. `src/lib/post-utils.ts` normalizes collection entries into `BlogPost`, which holds the raw Markdown body plus plain text for summaries — never pre-rendered HTML. Article pages use official `render(entry)` / `<Content />`; `astro.config.mjs` does not override `markdown.processor`, so Astro 7's default Rust-based Sätteri processor is used. Content comes from the owner's trusted local Obsidian vault, so no HTML sanitization is applied and `rehype-sanitize` / `@astrojs/markdown-remark` are not dependencies. Syntax highlighting is Astro's default Shiki; `src/lib/text.ts` only extracts plain text. Do not reintroduce `set:html` or a custom Markdown renderer; if untrusted content is ever accepted, add Sätteri `hastPlugins` or switch back to Unified with sanitization. Article images live in `src/content/posts/images/` and must use `./images/...` relative paths so Astro optimizes them to webp; never put article images in `public/`.
- All head tags live in `src/layouts/BaseLayout.astro`; `SITE_URL` is resolved at build time by `scripts/env.mjs` and shared by `astro.config.mjs` and `src/lib/site.ts`.
- Browser interactions belong in `src/scripts/*.js` as plain JavaScript and are imported from `<script>` tags in `.astro` components. Keep them framework-free. Search, tag filtering and pagination operate directly on pre-rendered DOM nodes; they never call an API.
- Fonts: browser-loaded fonts live in `public/fonts/` and are deployed; the ~20MB Chinese fonts used only to render OG images live in `src/assets/og-fonts/` and must never be moved into `public/`. The OG card tree lives in `src/lib/ogCard.ts` (pure, no `astro:content`); its main container must keep `boxSizing: 'border-box'` and the bottom tag/QR row must stay absolutely positioned, otherwise satori's content-box calculation pushes the QR code outside the 1200x675 canvas. `tests/og-image.test.ts` renders real SVGs to guard this.
- The site is deployed to EdgeOne Pages as **pure static files** (`edgeone.json`). `scripts/postbuild.mjs` scans `dist/` for article pages via `scripts/dist-pages.mjs` and writes flat `.html` fallbacks; it does not read a JSON manifest. There is no `/api/*`, Cloud Functions, Docker image, standalone static server, or Atom feed.
- **Keep dependencies minimal and prefer official, up-to-date Astro capabilities.** Use `astro/zod` for collection schemas (never add `zod` directly), the default Sätteri Markdown processor, default Shiki, `astro:assets` for images, and `sharp` (Astro's official default image service) to rasterize satori SVG into OG PNGs. Do not reintroduce `@resvg/resvg-js`, `@astrojs/markdown-remark`, `rehype-sanitize`, or any custom Markdown renderer. Bump Astro/oxlint to the latest patch when touching dependencies; TypeScript stays on 6.x only because `@astrojs/check` does not support 7.x yet.
- Use `bun install --frozen-lockfile`; the lockfile is `bun.lock`. All dependencies live in `dependencies` (Astro's recommendation); never introduce pnpm/npm/yarn lockfiles or `.nvmrc` (EdgeOne Pages would try to switch to a non-preinstalled Node version).
- `@astrojs/check@0.9.12` supports TypeScript 5/6 only, so TypeScript stays on 6.0.3 even though 7.x exists. Do not bump it without replacing the Astro type checker.
- Run `bun run typecheck && bun run lint && bun run test && bun run build && bun run check:edgeone` before proposing changes.
- `bun run publish` parses Obsidian Properties frontmatter without a YAML dependency: `parseFrontmatter()` handles `key: value` plus indented block sequences (`tags:\n  - AI`), and `parseTags()` normalizes block lists, inline arrays, comma-separated values and `#` prefixes into a string array written as `tags: [AI, 随笔]`. Note-declared tags are synced on updates; `slug` / `date` note properties are intentionally ignored to keep permalinks stable. Do not add a YAML package or drop block-sequence support.
- Git identity in this repo is fixed to `user.name=saibome` / `user.email=1995915+saibome@users.noreply.github.com` (GitHub-provided noreply). GitHub attributes contributors by the commit author email, so never commit with a `.local` or other placeholder email again: those commits show up as Anonymous. `.mailmap` maps the early `venbo` commits to the canonical identity for local git display only.
